_note: Folder-owned PUBLIC MIRROR declaration (ClosedSource/scripts/mirror_public.rb). This folder is the source of truth; the mirror repo is a generated, read-only copy and PRs happen here, never there. `include` lists what ships (folder-relative); `vendor` copies repo-root paths into the mirror (the JSE corpus rides along so the public repo's `npm test` runs standalone); `check` must exit 0 before any push (the conformance gate is the sync guarantee); `tag_from` cuts a v<version> tag on the mirror whenever that file's `version` changes. Nothing repo-specific lives in the script or the lane; add a mirror.json to any folder to make it a public mirror.
